description: Minister of Health and Mass Media - Food Act.No.26 of 1980 Iodization of Salt Regulations.
reasoning: This gazette content involves the amendment of regulations under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980. It specifically modifies the Food (Iodization of Salt) Regulations 2023, changing the effective date of implementation. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving legal/statutory instruments, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
